news.title: Password Manager Breach — mSecure Users Told to Change All Passwords
news.excerpt:
Password manager mSecure just told all users to change every password stored in their vault — but won't say what actually happened. On November 3, mSeven Software emailed customers about "suspicious activity" and said to immediately change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys. They didn't say when it happened, what was accessed, or if your data was stolen. Because the scope is unknown, assume the worst: change your most important passwords first (email, banking, work) through each service's official website. Use a different, strong password for each. Consider moving to a different password manager until mSecure explains what happened.

Source: Malwarebytes — November 4–6, 2026

news.title: That 'Gift Card Payment' Demand Is a Scam — Hang Up
news.excerpt:
The phone rings. The caller says you owe money — taxes, a utility bill, a court fine — and the only way to pay today is with gift cards. "Go to the store, buy Apple or Google Play cards, read me the numbers on the back."

No real government agency or legitimate company asks for gift cards. Ever. Gift cards are for gifts. Once you read the numbers, the money is gone and you can't get it back.

What to do: Hang up. If you're worried you owe something, look up the official number yourself and call. Never pay anyone with gift cards. Never read card numbers to anyone on the phone.

The rule: Gift cards are for presents. If someone demands them as payment, it's a scam. Every single time.

Source: FTC.gov — October 2026

news.title: Microsoft Patched a Critical Office Flaw — Check If You're Protected
news.excerpt: Microsoft fixed a dangerous Office flaw last month — opening a booby-trapped document could let someone run commands on your PC. The patch came through the regular update channel. Open Word or Excel, click File > Account > Update Options, and choose Update Now to confirm you are protected. Install the update at Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates to confirm you are running the fix. The critical vulnerability was discovered by security researchers analyzing document files that contained malicious macros. The flaw affected multiple Office products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook on Windows and Mac. The patch addresses a remote code execution vulnerability that could be triggered simply by opening an infected...

news.title: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws to must-patch list — Adobe Commerce and Google Brotli
news.excerpt:
CISA added two actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaws affect Adobe Commerce/Magento (CVE-2026-XXXXX) and Google Brotli (CVE-2026-YYYYY). Both have been exploited in real-world attacks. If you run Adobe Commerce/Magento, patch immediately at about.adobe.com/security/security-bulletin. If you use Google Brotli, update via github.com/google/brotli or your OS package manager. Organizations running either platform are urged to apply patches immediately to mitigate the risk of data breaches and system compromise.

Both vulnerabilities have confirmed active exploitation. Apply patches as soon as possible and monitor for any signs of compromise in your environment.

posts.title: Columbia County Library card unlocks free LinkedIn Learning ebooks and databases
posts.summary: Get a free library card at columbiacountylib.org or walk in at 135 NE Hernando Ave Suite 203 — access LinkedIn Learning courses, Libby ebooks/audiobooks, research databases, and streaming video.
posts.truth: People pay hundreds for LinkedIn Learning — it's free with your library card. Same for Consumer Reports, Ancestry, newspapers, language learning. Best deal in Lake City.

posts.title: Comcast Xfinity Fiber Now Reaches 4,700+ Columbia County Homes — Check Your Address at xfinity.com
posts.summary: Comcast announced Xfinity and Comcast Business fiber is now available to over 4,700 homes and businesses in Columbia County. Go to xfinity.com, enter your address, and see if gigabit fiber is at your door — or call 1-800-XFINITY.
posts.truth: People assume Lake City is stuck with slow internet. Two fiber builders — Comcast and Clearwave — are racing here now. I've had three customers this month switch from DSL to fiber and wonder why they waited.

posts.title: Firefox 160 Beta Brings Mini Window Multitasking and Playback Speed Controls — Free Update at firefox.com November 10
posts.summary: Firefox 160 launches November 10 with Mini Window (pop any tab into an always-on-top window), PiP playback speed 0.25x–2x, and stronger Android local-network privacy. Download free at firefox.com or join Beta at firefox.com/channel/desktop/ for early access.
posts.truth: Most people tolerate browser annoyances for years. Mini Window alone — keeping docs visible while you work elsewhere — changes how you use the web daily. I switched a customer to Firefox last week just for this.

posts.title: **Headline:** Windows Voice Typing (Win+H) types for you free — built into Windows 11
posts.summary: Press Win+H anywhere to dictate text — no install needed, works offline, handles punctuation commands like 'period' 'comma' 'new line'.
posts.truth: Most people don't realize Windows has had solid dictation for years — I show this to customers who struggle with typing and they're amazed it's free and already there.

posts.title: Windows Clipboard History (Win+V) remembers everything you copy — free built-in
posts.summary: Press Win+V to see your clipboard history — pin items you reuse, sync across your devices, clear with one click.
posts.truth: I watch people copy-paste the same thing five times a day — Win+V lets you grab yesterday's copied text instantly. It's the most underused Windows feature.

posts.title: Fake Antivirus Renewal Emails Steal Your Credit Card — Check Subscription Status Directly in the App
posts.summary: If an email says your Norton or McAfee subscription renewed for $80–$100, don't click the link. Open the security app on your computer or go to norton.com / mcafee.com directly to check your real status.
posts.truth: This scam works because antivirus renewals are confusing — the product came with the PC, someone else manages it, or you forgot. The email exploits that uncertainty. I see two customers a month who nearly paid.

posts.title: Ventoy Makes a Bootable USB With Multiple ISOs Free — No Reformatting Needed at ventoy.net
posts.summary: Download Ventoy free at ventoy.net, run Ventoy2Disk.exe, pick your USB, and drag ISO files onto it — no reformatting between installs. One drive boots Windows 11, Linux, MemTest86, and rescue tools.
posts.truth: I used to carry a bag of labeled USBs. Now one Ventoy drive replaces all of them. When a customer brings a dead laptop, I boot the right tool in seconds — Windows installer, drive diagnostics, password reset, you name it.
